1: Chapter 1: A Visitor on a Rainy Night
It had been raining in Qingshi for three full days. Lin Xiaoyu’s older sister, Chun Tian, had gone to the capital, leaving Lin Xiaoyu to tend the little apothecary alone.
After dark, she shut the doors and windows, counted the day’s takings, blew out the oil lamp, and went upstairs.
She had just lain down when urgent knocking came from downstairs, followed by a man’s voice: “Is anyone there?”
Standing outside the door was a young man soaked through, a bloodstained strip of cloth wrapped around his left arm. He said his name was Bai Yun and that he was a member of the Azure Dragon Society.
“I need this wound bandaged,” Bai Yun said quietly. “I can pay. Would three thousand five hundred copper coins be enough?”
He took a letter wrapped in oiled paper from inside his clothes. “This letter must be delivered to Qingfeng before May 18.”
As she bandaged his wound, he gave a rue smile. “If my fiancée knew I was knocking on a girl’s door in the middle of the night, she’d definitely be jealous.”
Lin Xiaoyu did not take his money. She only said, “First thing tomorrow morning, I’ll take you up the mountain.”
2: It was barely light when the two set out. Lin Xiaoyu carried a bamboo basket on her back, filled with dried rations, medicinal herbs, and an old umbrella.

Halfway up the mountain, they met Zhou Dashan, an old man gathering firewood. He set down his axe and lowered his voice. Yesterday evening, three outsiders had asked at the entrance to town about an injured young man.
“Xiaoyu, take the mountain path,” Zhou Dashan said. “It isn’t safe on the main road.” Lin Xiaoyu thanked him.
The mountain path was narrow and slippery. Lin Xiaoyu walked ahead, placing each step carefully and firmly. Bai Yun followed behind without saying a word.

At noon, the rain stopped, and the mist slowly lifted, revealing the rooftops of Qingfeng in the distance. A nun stood at the temple entrance. Her name was Zhao Qiuyue, and she was the temple’s attendant for receiving guests.
Zhao Qiuyue took the letter, examined the red seal on its flap, and nodded. “The abbess has been waiting for this letter for 2 years.”
Bai Yun said to Lin Xiaoyu, “I owe you my life.” Lin Xiaoyu laughed. “Then when you next come, help me repair the roof of the medicine shop.” Bai Yun stayed at the temple.
That evening, Lin Xiaoyu descended the mountain alone. By the time she reached home, it was already dark. She lit the lamp and sat behind the counter for a long time.
